title: Harden IK chain rest-position and link-length domain contracts
description: Extend the existing IK boundary hardening so BoneChain rejects non-finite rest positions and non-finite/non-positive link lengths before FABRIK is invoked. Previously malformed Skeleton data could turn Vector3.Distance into NaN/Infinity and rely on a later solver check to diagnose it. Keep validated input behavior unchanged and preserve BoneChain's role as the Skeleton-to-position adapter.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: BoneChain.ExtractRestPositions now rejects non-finite bone positions; ComputeLinkLengths rejects non-finite endpoints and non-finite/non-positive distances. Added focused BoneChain regressions. No Unity execution was performed in this harness.
